rows.description: The `open_valve_MV101` endpoint initiates the opening of raw-water inlet valve MV101 to supply tank T101.
The `open_valve_MV101` endpoint opens raw-water inlet valve MV101, feeding tank T101.
Use this endpoint to tell component MV101 to open the raw-water inlet valve for tank T101.
The `open_valve_MV101` endpoint actuates the MV101 raw-water inlet valve to open, supplying tank T101.
To initiate water flow into Tank T101, send a request to the '/open_valve_MV101' endpoint.
The `close_valve_MV101` endpoint initiates closure of the raw-water inlet valve, component MV101, supplying tank T101.
The `/close_valve_MV101` endpoint closes the raw-water inlet valve MV101 feeding tank T101.
The `/close_valve_MV101` endpoint shuts off the flow of raw water into tank T101 via valve MV101.
The '/close_valve_MV101' endpoint initiates closure of raw-water inlet valve MV101, interrupting flow to tank T101.
To isolate tank T101 from the raw-water supply, send a POST request to the '/close_valve_MV101' endpoint.
The `/start_pump_P101` endpoint initiates operation of raw-water pump P101.
The `start_pump_P101` endpoint initiates operation of raw-water pump P101.
This endpoint will kick off raw-water pump P101.
The `start_pump_P101` endpoint initiates the operation of raw-water pump P101.
To initiate operation of raw-water pump P101, send a POST request to the 'start_pump_P101' endpoint.
The `stop_pump_P101` endpoint initiates the cessation of operation for raw-water pump P101.
The `/stop_pump_P101` endpoint halts operation of raw-water pump P101.
Use this endpoint to shut down raw-water pump P101.
The `stop_pump_P101` endpoint deactivates raw-water pump P101.
To halt raw-water pump operation, send a request to the `/stop_pump_P101` endpoint.
The `/open_valve_MV201` endpoint activates valve component MV201, diverting flow from T101 to the Process 2 dosing line.
Opens valve MV201 to permit flow from T101 to the Process 2 dosing line.
This endpoint tells MV201 to open the valve connecting T101 to the Process 2 dosing line.
The "open_valve_MV201" endpoint instructs component MV201 to open, allowing flow from T101 to the Process 2 dosing line.
To initiate flow, send a request to the '/open_valve_MV201' endpoint to open valve MV201 on the T101 connection to Process 2 dosing line.
The `close_valve_MV201` endpoint instructs the control system to close valve MV201, which regulates flow from T101 to the Process 2 dosing line.
The 'close_valve_MV201' endpoint closes valve MV201, interrupting flow from T101 to Process 2 dosing.
This endpoint simply tells component MV201 to close the valve on the T101 to Process 2 dosing line.
The `close_valve_MV201` endpoint commands the closure of valve MV201, diverting flow from T101 to the Process 2 dosing line.
To isolate Process 2, activate the 'close_valve_MV201' endpoint to close valve MV201, separating T101 from the dosing line.
The `/start_dosing_pump_P201` endpoint initiates the operation of hydrochloric acid (HCl) dosing pump P201.
Starts hydrochloric acid (HCl) dosing pump P201.
This endpoint will start up hydrochloric acid (HCl) dosing pump P201.
The "start_dosing_pump_P201" endpoint initiates the operation of hydrochloric acid (HCl) dosing pump P201.
To initiate the dispensing process for hydrochloric acid (HCl) by pump P201, execute the 'start_dosing_pump_P201' API endpoint.
The `stop_dosing_pump_P201` endpoint halts the operation of hydrochloric acid (HCl) dosing pump P201.
The `stop_dosing_pump_P201` endpoint halts operation of HCl dosing pump P201.
This endpoint will halt HCl dosing for pump P201.
The `/stop_dosing_pump_P201` endpoint halts operation of HCl dosing pump P201.
To halt HCl delivery from pump P201, send a request to the '/stop_dosing_pump_P201' endpoint.
The `set_dosing_rate` endpoint modifies the unitless dosing-rate multiplier for pump P201, with a nominal value of 1.0.
Sets the unitless dosing rate multiplier for pump P201 to a specified value (nominal 1.0).
Use this endpoint to tell pump P201 how fast to dose, with a default rate of 1.0.
The `set_dosing_rate` endpoint sets a unitless dosing-rate multiplier for pump P201, with a nominal value of 1.0.

To adjust the dosing rate of pump P201, send a PUT request to the '/set_dosing_rate' endpoint with the new unitless multiplier value. Let me know if you need help with other API documentation sentences!
The `read_level_T101` endpoint returns the level of tank T101 as a percentage full, as read by sensor LIT101.
The `read_level_T101` endpoint returns the level of tank T101 from LIT101 in %-full.
Use 'read_level_T101' to get the current level of tank T101 from sensor LIT101, expressed as a percentage full.
The `/read_level_T101` endpoint returns the level of tank T101 from sensor LIT101 in %-full.
Operators shall use the 'read_level_T101' endpoint to retrieve the level of tank T101 from sensor LIT101, expressed as a percentage of full capacity.
The `/read_level_T201` endpoint returns the level of tank T201 as a percentage of full, retrieved from the LIT201 component.
The 'read_level_T201' endpoint returns the level of tank T201 from LIT201 as a percentage full.
To get the current level of tank T201 from LIT201, you'd use the 'read_level_T201' endpoint which returns the percentage full.
The `read_level_T201` endpoint returns the level of tank T201 as a percentage full, measured by the LIT201 sensor.
Operators shall utilize the `/read_level_T201` endpoint to retrieve the level of tank T201 from LIT201, expressed as a percentage full.
The `read_flow_FIT101` endpoint returns the volumetric flow rate of inlet fluid into T101 from the FIT101 source.
The `read_flow_FIT101` endpoint returns the inlet flow into T101 from FIT101.
Check out the current inlet flow into T101 from FIT101 using the 'read_flow_FIT101' endpoint.
The `/read_flow_FIT101` endpoint returns the inlet flow rate (in units of liters per minute) into T101 from FIT101.
The `/read_flow_FIT101` endpoint returns the current inlet flow rate into T101 from FIT101.
The 'read_flow_FIT201' endpoint returns the volumetric flow rate measured between Process1 and Process2 by component FIT201.
The `read_flow_FIT201` endpoint returns the Process1->Process2 cross-stage flow measured by FIT201.
Get the flow rate between Process1 and Process2 measured by FIT201 using this endpoint.
The `read_flow_FIT201` endpoint returns the volumetric flow rate between Process1 and Process2 as measured by the FIT201 sensor.
Operators can retrieve the Process1->Process2 cross-stage flow from component FIT201 by making a GET request to the 'read_flow_FIT201' endpoint.
The '/read_chemical_AIT201' endpoint returns the conductivity reading for Process 2 as measured by the AIT201 sensor.
`read_chemical_AIT201` retrieves Process 2 conductivity measurements from sensor AIT201.
Get the conductivity reading for Process 2 from AIT201 using this endpoint.
The `/read_chemical_AIT201` endpoint returns the conductivity reading for Process 2 from sensor AIT201.
To retrieve Process 2 conductivity data, operators shall execute a GET request to the 'read_chemical_AIT201' endpoint, which returns readings from sensor AIT201.
